about: Library hooks as typed transitions (moonshot 8). A row names the package and the hook, the shape of its result (fields typed by the call's own type arguments where the checker resolves them), its effect class (what the call asks of the world), and what a callback it is handed may do. Lane A reads a listed call as a transition of the world returning the declared record; lane B's fake returns a record of that shape, each field a typed fake. A hook outside the table stays an opaque transition.

hooks.effect: a world read keyed by queryKey; queryFn runs later as an effect whose result becomes data
hooks.callback: queryFn: an effect, may read the world and return a value; never a setter

hooks.typeArgument: the mutationFn's awaited return type and its variables
hooks.effect: none at the call; mutate is an effect handle the environment may invoke later
hooks.callback: mutationFn, onSuccess, onError, onSettled: effects, run when mutate is invoked

hooks.effect: none at the call; every member is a navigation effect handle

hooks.typeArgument: the declared params record when given
hooks.effect: a world read of the current route

a read of the nearest provider element of the context above the hook's frame in the rendered tree (--deep), its value prop; with no provider element of that context in the rendered tree, and always at a unit's root, the outside value: one per context, the same at every frame and every render
hooks.laneA: a world read keyed by the context handle, the same transition on both sides: the provider of a unit's root is outside the unit, and a child is a name

hooks.effect: a world read of the locale; t is a lookup of the world's table, the same key giving the same string within one render
